problems: gazetteer: region 'Lower Egypt' (data/gazetteer/regions.jsonl line 534) includes the admin-1 units Matruh (524 cells) and Al Jizah (126 cells, mostly Western Desert); the region has 787 cells where the Delta and Cairo reach are about 180. 19 dossiers use it (maadi-culture, naqada-culture, achaemenid-empire, fatimid-caliphate, kingdom-of-kush, new-kingdom-of-egypt, the 21st-25th, 30th and 31st dynasties, fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt and others). Fixing the region (drop Matruh, restrict Al Jizah to the Nile) would repair them all; my override then becomes redundant but harmless.

after the patch the trial lists a new keyframe snap naqada-culture_-3200 (added 51, removed 10; Delta cells the ledger leaves unowned at the snap); the state follows the corrected keyframe, the snap is the patch's own and needs nothing.
